prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity LANDSCAPE desktop web-app visual concept, roughly 1600x1000, for BeanFeature Lab, a serious Russian-language scientific experiment tool. This is CONCEPT A: 'Приборная рабочая станция' (Instrument Workbench), an Operate-mode interface with a charcoal ink-gray base, warm off-white working canvas, muted cobalt primary action, flat 1px rules, restrained square-ish MUI-compatible controls, no glow. Composition: narrow left project/navigation rail grouped as Исследование / Анализ / Применение; across the top a compact project and dataset status bar; at center a VERY LARGE empty Plotly-style quality-versus-feature-budget plotting stage occupying at least half the viewport; right-hand narrow context inspector showing selector 'Mutual Information', model controls and criterion 'Допустимая потеря Macro-F1: 0.01'; below plot a compact table header for feature choices. Plot area MUST contain only axes/grid, x axis 'Число исходных признаков k' with protocol ticks 1 to 16, y label 'Macro-F1', and prominent honest empty-state label 'Не рассчитано'. No curves, points, bars, confidence intervals, model ranking, percentages, metrics, observed values, or scientific conclusions. Labels in Russian where legible: 'BeanFeature Lab', 'Бюджет признаков', 'Эксперименты', 'Запуски', 'Анализ признаков', 'Сравнение', 'Классификатор', 'Датасет не загружен', 'Запуск не выбран'. Clear button 'Создать эксперимент'. Use professional readable Cyrillic sans, tabular numerals, monospace only for future IDs. Visual language is a restrained precision instrument, not a dashboard template: no hero, no KPI cards, no glass, no gradient, no agriculture imagery, no seeds/leaves, no robot icons, no Lucide-like decorative icon emphasis. Standard controls should look implementable with MUI Core and MUI X Data Grid Community. The UI should visibly prioritize the large scientific chart and task state. No fake data of any kind.
